2225-2493-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-2493-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

678-4939-5256.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2393-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2393-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-728-2459-2500.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror.
Repeat.

856-3899-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-4268.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-4268.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4863-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4863-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3525-5268-7938.description:
Activate Shuttle Ace by tapping it, adding {U}.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace.
Repeat.

5078-5705-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Sensei's Divining Top. When it enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

880-3470-7892.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

301-4738-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
301-4738-7804.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and then putting the card back on top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

876-1355-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
876-1355-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Sanctum Weaver.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Sanctum Weaver.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Sanctum Weaver from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2866-4970-5751-7692--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3192-6797-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
3192-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2617-7150-7309.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
2617-7150-7309.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Don & Leo's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Don & Leo's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.

38-659-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-7297.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

914-3335-4742.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3335-4742.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-3335-4742.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1017-3532-4668-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1017-3532-4668-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Falco Spara.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

141-413-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-413-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-2762.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating three 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

640-5010-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2292-5220-6537-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

1110-4186-6919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
1110-4186-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Scurry Oak.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

4899-4996-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 6 or higher.
4899-4996-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling a card.
Repeat step 1 until you've exiled your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat step 4.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-4558-5913-6797.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-4558-5913-6797.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

222-997-2060-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 4 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-997-2060-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-997-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

252-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

129-1247-6006.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Kinnan triggers, adding one mana of the color that was produced.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

31-212-1068-6309.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it and Canoptek Spyder trigger.
Resolve Leveler's ability, exiling your library.
Resolve Canoptek Spyder's trigger, returning Necron Deathmark from your graveyard to the battlefield with Out of the Tombs instead of drawing a card.
When Necron Deathmark enters the battlefield, it and Canoptek Spyder trigger.
Resolve Necron Deathmark's ability, destroying itself and causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 4.
31-212-1068-6309.notes: You can pull off this combo in the Necron Dynasties Warhammer 40K preconstructed Commander deck, if you mill your entire library the hard way instead of using Leveler. In that version of this combo, you do not need to draw any cards beside Out of the Tombs, as you can begin by returning Triarch Praetorian, which then returns the two creature combo pieces.

643-1789-2292-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-3259-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
1251-3259-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1274-2999-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2999-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

372-3378-4863.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3378-4863.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

997-1228-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
997-1228-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-1974.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Quicksilver Gargantuan.
1621-1974.description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Quicksilver Gargantuan enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Quicksilver Gargantuan. Choose to have Quicksilver Gargantuan enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

116-2569-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima's Student is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Sakashima's Student do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-5241.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Sakashima's Student.
Activate Sakashima's Student by tapping it.
When Sakashima's Student becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Sakashima's Student's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3499-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ioreth of the Healing House

1430-1432-1434.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional legendary creature.
1430-1432-1434.description:
Activate Mirror Image's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature you control.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Mirror Image and another legendary creature you control.
Repeat.

283-561-1978-4474-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Voltaic Construct.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
283-561-1978-4474-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {1}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Maestros Theater from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Maestros Theater enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Mountain, Island or Swamp and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, targeting Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Voltaic Construct's ability, targeting Scaretiller.
Resolve the copy of Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve the original Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

978-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
978-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid by putting a zero -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies, untapping it.
Repeat.
